technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Cloud Stream 3.x (or latest) with the functional programming model for all ported modules.

Modules will be published as separate starters or as part of the Spring Cloud Stream project repository (s-c-s).
Adopt the existing Spring Cloud Stream project structure, build configuration (Maven/Gradle), and CI/CD pipelines.

Migration documentation will cover breaking changes, new features, and configuration differences between Spring Cloud Stream 1.2 and 1.3.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD modules are well-tested, documented, and their core logic can be reused with minimal refactoring.
The development team has solid experience with Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Integration, and the target external systems (Redis, RabbitMQ, GemFire, FTP, HDFS).
Integration testing environments for all external systems (Redis, RabbitMQ, GemFire, FTP, HDFS with HDP/PHD) are readily available.
No major architectural changes are required beyond adapting the modules to the Spring Cloud Stream programming model.
The HDFS module already exists in the s-c-s repository and only requires dependency updates and compatibility testing for new HDP/PHD distros.
The migration strategy documentation (U8) is focused on Spring Cloud Stream version upgrades (1.2 to 1.3) and not on Spring XD migration.
Effort estimates are for a single developer with relevant expertise and include analysis, design, implementation, unit/integration testing, and documentation for each module.
Code review, merge, and release activities are included within each activity's estimate.

Analyze the XD FTP module, design and implement a Spring Cloud Stream sink binder/function for FTP/FTPS/SFTP, handle protocol variations, write tests, update documentation, and integrate into s-c-s repo.
Analyze the XD redis module, design and implement a Spring Cloud Stream sink binder/function for Redis, write tests, update documentation, and integrate into s-c-s repo.
Analyze the XD rabbit module, design and implement a Spring Cloud Stream source binder/function for RabbitMQ, write tests, update documentation, and integrate into s-c-s repo.
Analyze the XD gemfire module, design and implement a Spring Cloud Stream sink binder/function for GemFire, write tests, update documentation, and integrate into s-c-s repo.
